Available Types of Accessories

Phone Cases

Phone cases help protect a device from scratches, minor impacts and daily wear. Buyers should select a case made for the exact phone model because camera placement, buttons and body dimensions can differ between devices.

Materials and design also affect the experience. A slim case improves portability, while a more protective design may add weight and thickness.

Magnetic and MagSafe Cases

Magnetic cases are designed to support compatible magnetic accessories or charging systems. Before purchasing, customers should confirm that both the phone and the intended charger, stand or wallet support the same magnetic system.

Screen Protectors and Privacy Films

Screen protectors help reduce scratches and direct damage to a device’s display. Privacy films can also reduce side-angle viewing, which may be useful in offices, cafés, public transport and other shared environments.

Customers should verify the exact screen size and device model. Installation type, transparency, touch response and removability may also influence the buying decision.

Laptop Sleeves and Cases

Laptop sleeves protect a device while it is stored or carried. The size must match the laptop because a loose sleeve provides less stability, while an undersized one may not fit.

Buyers should compare interior padding, material, closure type and portability. A sleeve can provide everyday protection but may not offer the same impact resistance as a reinforced laptop bag.

Chargers and Power Adapters

Chargers and power adapters provide power to smartphones, tablets, laptops and other compatible devices. Wattage alone does not guarantee the fastest charging speed. The connected device, cable and charging protocol must also be compatible.

Customers should check output, port type and supported charging standards before buying.

Cables and Adapters

Cables and adapters connect devices for charging, data transfer, audio, video or accessory support. Buyers should identify the required connector, such as USB Type-C, Lightning or another supported format.

Cable quality, length and data capability should be considered alongside charging support.

Smartphone Gimbals

A smartphone gimbal helps stabilize video while walking, vlogging or recording moving subjects. It is useful for content creators, travellers and social-media users who want smoother handheld footage.

Compatibility, supported phone size, payload, application requirements and included accessories should be reviewed before purchasing.
